questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “HTTP, MQTT, and protocol choice”?
options: QoS controls delivery guarantees and retransmission behavior.
A gateway is not mandatory in every deployment; choose architecture for the actual network.
HTTP is request/response; MQTT is pub/sub.
Devices measure, communication transports data, and services consume it.
questions.answer: HTTP is request/response; MQTT is pub/sub.
questions.explanation:
HTTP is request/response; MQTT is pub/sub.
Why: HTTP suits request/response APIs; MQTT suits brokered publish/subscribe telemetry. Choose based on network conditions, latency, message size, QoS, and device constraints.
